React · TypeScript · MediaPipe

HandPong

Classic Pong, controlled by your hand. Real-time webcam hand tracking with MediaPipe Hands maps your index fingertip to the paddle — no controller, no keyboard required. Move your hand up and down to defend your side and beat the built-in AI. Mouse and keyboard fallbacks are built in for when the camera is unavailable.

Play

Launch the live game in your browser. Allow camera access, then move your hand to control the paddle.

How to play

Calibrate your control band, tune smoothing and sensitivity, and switch input modes on the fly.

How it works

The pipeline: webcam frames → MediaPipe Hands landmarks → smoothed paddle target → canvas physics loop.

Source

MIT-licensed on GitHub. React + Vite single-page app, deployed to GitHub Pages from main.
